# Darklight Chess Academy

> Darklight Chess Academy is a chess academy based in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, India. It teaches live online chess classes to students worldwide and offline classes at two centres in Coimbatore, for children and adults from complete beginner to tournament level.

Key facts (as published on this website):
- Founder: Karuppasamy. Co-founder and Head Coach: Manikandan.
- Formats: live online classes (group batches, private 1-to-1 lessons, sibling classes) and offline classes in Coimbatore.
- Online batches: standard India-timing batches plus an international batch for other time zones.
- Levels: beginner, intermediate, advanced and tournament preparation.
- Enrolment starts with a free demo class and level assessment. Fees are shared on enquiry; no price list is published.
- Offline centres: 4th Street, NSR Rd, Saibaba Colony, Coimbatore 641011; VV Complex, 14, Sowripalayam Rd, Rukmani Nagar, Coimbatore 641028.
- Contact: +91 83001 55259 (phone / WhatsApp), darklightchess64@gmail.com
